import os
import sys
import warnings
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
try:
    import lightgbm as lgb
except ImportError:
    !pip install -q lightgbm

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def solve():
    # Define paths
    train_path = "./input/train.csv"
    test_path = "./input/test.csv"
    sample_sub_path = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
    submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"

    # Load Data
    train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)  # Verify format

    # Feature Engineering & Extraction
    id_col = "Id"
    target_col = "Cover_Type"
    feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != id_col and col != target_col]

    X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
    y_train = train_df[target_col].values
    X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
    test_ids = test_df[id_col].values.astype(np.int64)

    # Create a hold-out validation set for scoring
    X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
        X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=True, stratify=y_train
    )

    # Convert to LightGBM Dataset format
    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_split, label=y_train_split)
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val_split, label=y_val_split, reference=train_data)

    # Training parameters optimized for tabular data
    params = {
        'objective': 'multiclass',
        'num_class': len(pd.unique(y_train)),
        'boosting_type': 'gbdt',
        'learning_rate': 0.05,
        'n_estimators': 1000,
        'verbose': -1,
        'min_child_samples': 20,
        'reg_alpha': 0.1,
        'reg_lambda': 0.1,
        'random_state': 42
    }

    # Train with early stopping
    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data,
        num_boost_round=1000,
        valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50, verbose=False), lgb.log_evaluation(0)]
    )

    # Evaluate on validation set (Hold-out)
    val_pred = model.predict(X_val_split)
    validation_acc = accuracy_score(y_val_split, val_pred)
    print(f"Validation Accuracy: {validation_acc:.4f}")

    # Generate predictions for the actual test set
    test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

    # Ensure prediction values are integers
    test_pred = test_pred.astype(np.int64)

    # Prepare submission
    submission_data = {id_col: test_ids, target_col: test_pred}
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_data)

    # Ensure directory exists
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(submission_path), exist_ok=True)

    # Save submission
    submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

    print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
    print("Done.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
